name: Mamiya Ririka
source:
Ririka is one of the relatives of [url=https://vndb.org/c11965]Kisaya[/url], she likes her a lot. She is also a relative of [url=https://vndb.org/c67885]Hirotsugu[/url] but she is afraid of him.

[spoiler]She doesn't like [url=https://vndb.org/c19116]Akihito[/url] at first because she thinks he isn't enough good for Kisaya. Her opinion of him change after she is blackmailed by Hirotsugu and she starts seeing Akihito as a very good man.

Her feelings change to the point where she openly declares to be Kisaya's rival to get Akihito's love and she is ready to get it all.[/spoiler]
